new.n: Hermit brothers' gold in a trapper shack, 3 mi SW of Palmyra (part found 1927)
new.pl: About 3 mi SW of Palmyra on the bearing (1927 AP); the ~10-acre farm is not on the c.1915 Hixson plats of Palmyra, Sumner, Sullivan, Whitewater or La Grange (bought after 1915 or rented); may lie across the Walworth line
new.st: Two hermit brothers, trappers and well-diggers, lived on a 10-acre farm 3 mi SW of Palmyra. After the elder died in Nov 1926 aged 90, several thousand dollars in gold turned up in old shoes, tin cans and the rafters. Hunters kept searching the shack for more, and part of the yard was to be dug after the spring thaw; no result was reported. Farm not yet located; private: permission. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
new.t: Part found; the yard dig result was never reported. Place the 10-acre farm from a 1920s Jefferson Co plat or tax roll. Private: permission.
pinev: Bearing-only: 3 mi SW of Palmyra from the 1927 AP story; the farm is not on the c.1915 plats (about 2.5 km).
